blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Sunday called on Filipinos to extend the spirit of remembrance during All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day to acts of compassion, particularly toward people who are struggling. In his message for Undas, Marcos said the devotion Filipinos show in honoring their departed loved ones should also be reflected in how they treat those around them, including those who need help and understanding. “If we can make time to revere those who have passed, we can also make room to listen to those who struggle, and let that same concern guide our society […]...
